record_type: Point-in-time source-body qualification of 35 reference definitions
authority: Historical inspection record. The issue tracker owns subsequent work and live status. No source imports or execution occurred. Proposed independent checks did not run in this audit.

selection.join: Join each definition id to docs/sprints/semiconductor-function-gap-ledger.json definitions. Join source_file_id below to source_files for exact path and SHA-256.
selection.historical_cohort_policy: Retain the original 19 and 16 IDs even when the current census refines their dispositions. These counts do not mean 35 missing application operations.

B-device.api: Python native adapter plus explicit extraction API

bridgeless_comparison.classification: Existing core and existing named sc-bridgeless preset. No missing solver, preset, or generic aggregation operation follows from this source wrapper.
bridgeless_comparison.source_outputs: Nine per-device conduction/on/off power vectors, arithmetic sample means, and each mean multiplied by two.
bridgeless_comparison.current_outputs: Component energies and duration-based mean powers, scaled physical-member totals, retained bindings, models, and assumptions. Optional circuit summary adds explicit die/junction heat ownership and independent fixed-sink paths.
bridgeless_comparison.active_path_qualification: Nonnegative net power selects the disclosed source inactivity assumption. It is not physical proof of zero branch current. Use custom bindings and supplied signed branch currents when that assumption does not apply. Keep omitted contributions unknown.
bridgeless_comparison.corrected_inline_claim: An earlier inline statement that the current package lacked an equivalent bridgeless workflow was incorrect. Whole-package inspection found the named preset.

11.qualification: One bounded conditioning/statistics group. Source warm-up zeros, negative-shift tail defects, identifier lists, unchanged derivative units, Nyquist doubling, and fixed window corrections are not port targets.

12.qualification: A real functional difference from current exact-temperature slices. A separate held-out data qualification must describe physical accuracy. A proposed bilinear I/T method is not implemented or tested by this audit.
